c1_keyword_baseline.definition: keyword baseline: firm brand token or any >=4-char token of the product code's generic device name appears in a firm-verified record inside the window

c3_decoy.definition: same firm, different product code, anchor date within the frozen window: the donor's distinctive token replaces the milestone's token
c3_decoy.specificity_note: specificity = real rate / decoy rate, both on the same denominator (anchors that received a decoy). A null value means the decoy rate was zero, which is unbounded above rather than a pass.

c4a_time_shift.definition: anchor date shifted by a random offset in +/-[90,1095] days, evidence and tokens held fixed, window recomputed around the shifted date

c4b_date_permutation.definition: anchor dates permuted among anchors of the same firm and year; tokens fixed
